title: Create compactor.py — compaction logic with archive (never delete)
acceptance_criteria: compact_memory(memory) → Result[dict, Err]: returns compacted memory with epoch_summaries added
archive_originals(decisions, compacted_ids) → list[dict]: moves original decisions to archived_decisions field (never deletes)
build_compaction_report(before_count, after_count, epoch_count) → dict with stats
Compacted decisions replace originals; originals preserved in archived_decisions
Result type on all business logic — no exceptions raised from pure functions
Epoch summaries have: epoch_id, merged_text, original_ids, timestamp, confidence_tier
Functions are pure (except memory dict mutation which is the explicit output)
